evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/n/b/a stores a task interval and last-run timestamp; b() compares System.currentTimeMillis() against them, invokes the abstract c() work hook when interval is zero or due, then records the new last-run timestamp.
The class owns three typed static registries for R288 DeferredHoverTask, rs/n/b/a/a TimedInterfaceTask and R288 InterfaceRenderTask, plus a shared registry list that is globally ticked.

Accepted R288 evidence fixes the three subclasses as interface hover/render/timed task categories keyed and dispatched by RSInterface/widget id, binding the base abstraction to interface tasks rather than a generic scheduler.
